title: Simulation 3D Light Helicopter Pack
text: Generate translation and rotation information for light helicopter, 12 inputs, 2 outputs, {Select input coordinate frame} sets Input coordinate frame; {Engine translation} sets the option to enable Engine_T input port, {Rotor 1 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor1_T input port, {Rotor 2 translation} sets the option to enable Rotor2_T input port, {Engine rotation} sets the option to enable Engine_R input port, {Rotor 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor1_R input port, {Rotor 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Rotor2_R input port, {Sensor 1 translation} sets the option to enable Sensor1_T input port, {Sensor 2 translation} sets the option to enable Sensor2_T input port, {Sensor 1 rotation} sets the option to enable Sensor1_R input port and {Sensor 2 rotation} sets the option to enable Sensor2_R input port. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Engine translation
params.values: Option to enable Engine_T input port off (default) | on

params.name: Rotor 1 translation
params.values: Option to enable Rotor1_T input port off (default) | on

params.values: Option to enable Rotor2_T input port off (default) | on

params.values: Option to enable Engine_R input port off (default) | on

params.name: Rotor 1 rotation
params.values: Option to enable Rotor1_R input port off (default) | on

params.name: Rotor 2 rotation
params.values: Option to enable Rotor2_R input port off (default) | on
